1. The Service

XianNow is a photography and creative app. Its features may include camera capture, Frames/templates and mood effects, filters and effects, text and layer editing, personal template and filter management, shooting with a character, saving and browsing photos, weather-based moods, a film-roll balance, and film-roll purchases. Available features depend on the current App version, your device, and the descriptions shown in the App.

In the current version, most creative data, templates, filter settings, shooting history, and your film-roll balance are stored on your device. This version does not provide a XianNow account, cloud backup of creations, or cross-device sync. Uninstalling the App, clearing App data, resetting your device, or device damage may make local data unrecoverable. You manage work saved to the system photo library through iOS Photos.

4. Film-Roll Items and In-App Purchases

  1. The App currently offers trial film rolls and film rolls obtained through purchase or redemption in the Apple App Store. Product names, quantities, prices, currencies, and purchase conditions are those displayed in the App and Apple's confirmation screen at the time of purchase. Digital purchases are completed through Apple StoreKit and the App Store. Check the item and price before paying.
  2. The trial balance is replenished to 20 shots each month and does not accumulate. Permanently purchased or redeemed film rolls do not expire. One shot is reserved when you take a photo and deducted after the finished image saves successfully. If capture, generation, or saving fails, the App restores the shot according to its records. Trial shots are used before permanent shots. Saving or sharing an already-saved image again does not consume another shot. The in-App explanation and current product behavior control the detailed rules.
  3. In this local version, the film-roll balance is stored on the current device and does not yet sync across devices. Changing or resetting a device may make a local balance unrecoverable.
